_readme: Local switches for testing. Copy this file to Local/switches.json (git ignores Local/). The game reads it at the start of each scene and each Cut; a missing file means every switch is off. autoplay: the human seat sends the canned lines in Content/NHOS/Data/autoplay.json instead of waiting for typed input. force_tie: The Cut rewrites the vote targets into a cycle, so every actor on stage gets one vote and the Director breaks the tie. spare_human: The Cut moves every vote for the human to another actor on stage, so the human is never cut and a show plays all its scenes (for testing the scene 2 path and the win screen; a moved vote keeps its old reason). free_mode: every ask goes to the relay with "free": true, so no LLM is called and no tokens are spent; the AIs answer with the pre-written lines in Content/NHOS/Data/free_mode.json. It is read once when the show loads, and it decides the mode for autoplay runs, which skip the title screen. On the title screen, Test for Free and Play with LLMs override it.
